# CoLab Lisbon

> CoLab Lisbon runs hands-on AI workshops and Claude training in Lisbon, Portugal. Learn to build products, agents, and automations with Claude and Claude Code — in person, with a community of AI builders.

## Key Information

- **Organization**: CoLab Lisbon
- **Location**: Lisbon, Portugal
- **Focus**: Claude AI training, AI agents, workflow automation, Claude Code
- **Languages**: English (primary), Portuguese (Português)
- **Target Audience**: Entrepreneurs, founders, freelancers, marketing professionals, executives

## Next Workshop: Next Level AI

- **Location**: Unicorn Factory, Lisbon
- **Registration**: https://luma.com/o8lhzuz4
- **Format**: 2-day intensive, in-person workshop
- **Instructors**: Chelsea Rustrum, James Corbett, Verena Husemann

### What You'll Learn
- Day 1: Agentic thinking and workflow orchestration with Claude
- Day 2: Design and deploy automated systems for real business use cases
- Go beyond basic prompting into advanced Claude techniques
- Build operator-level frameworks and multi-step workflows
- Leave with working products, agents, and automations

### Who It's For
- You prompt & chat with AI but haven't built real systems yet
- Entrepreneurs wanting to automate busywork
- Founders building products with AI
- Professionals seeking to streamline workflows
